Mixed purées

Chicken and apple with couscous

Csirkés alma kuszkusszal

6 months+ Adjusted 30 min 4 portions

The apple is only a flavour and the chicken is the iron. No cherries and no stock. This contains gluten.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 120 g skinless chicken thigh (raw weight)
  • 60 g apple (prepared weight, peeled, cored, and cooked; a flavour, not the bulk)
  • 40 g fine couscous (wheat, so gluten)
  • 80 ml hot water (unsalted, not stock)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Cook the chicken in unsalted water until there is no pink in the middle, then shred it very fine.
  2. Peel, core, and cook the apple until soft, then mash it.
  3. Stir the couscous into hot water, not stock, and cover for 5 minutes.
  4. Mash the couscous with a spoon of water so no dry grains remain.
  5. Mix chicken, apple, and couscous and mash until spoonable.
  6. Do not add cherries or salt.

Adjusted

Whole cherries are a choking hazard and do not belong in this dish. Salty stock is often used to cook the couscous.

Use cooked apple only as a flavour, and keep the chicken as the iron-rich part. Cook the couscous in water rather than stock, and count the gluten from the wheat.
